Subject: Thank you for today's call - pilot timeline and next steps

Hi Acme team,

Thank you for the productive conversation today.

Quick recap of what we aligned on:
- Pilot timeline approved for May.
- Legal review to be completed by Friday.
- Next sync scheduled for Tuesday at 11:00 (Paris time).

Please let me know if you want any adjustment to the plan.

Best regards,
Jean-Baptiste

Subject: Follow-up and new meeting options

Hi,

I hope you are well. We missed each other at our scheduled meeting, so I wanted to follow up and suggest two new options next week:
- Tuesday 14:00 (Paris)
- Thursday 10:30 (Paris)

If neither works, feel free to share a better slot.

Best regards,
Jean-Baptiste
